title: WATCH: President Trump Expertly Shuts Down a Rude Kaitlan Collins When She Asks a Question as a Way to Blame Him for Future Inflation | The Gateway Pundit | by Cullen Linebarger
text: President Trump humiliated one of his favorite media targets during an important press conference on Thursday. As The Gateway Pundit’s Jordan Conradson reported , Trump held his first of two press conferences at 1 pm ET today, where he discussed reciprocal tariffs during an executive order signing. He also read to reporters “some of the names that hundreds of millions and even billions of dollars have been given to.” CNN’s Kaitlan Collins decided to take the opportunity to grease a false narrative to pin Trump responsible for inflation supposedly caused by the tariffs. This comes after she and other corporate media ‘journalists’ covered for the Biden regime and lied to the public about the economy for years. As Trump was signing his executive order on tariffs and displayed it to reporters, Collins made her move. “Mr. President, you won the White House in part because of high inflation,”she began. “If your tariffs make prices go up…” “Excuse me, we haven’t asked you to speak yet, please,” Trump replied. Collins then went silent as Trump continued to display the executive order and then move on to other questions. WATCH: KAITLAN COLLINS: Mr. President, you won the White House, in part because of high inflation. He responded by dunking on her again. “This should’ve been done by Biden years ago,” Trump told her. “I know he’s a friend of yours.
